# ellmercodex

> **Documentación en español:** empieza por [Primeros
> pasos](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/ellmercodex-es.html).
> Todos los artículos están disponibles en español.

`ellmercodex` lets you use your ChatGPT plan from R as an
[`ellmer`](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/) provider. You sign in once
with your ChatGPT account, and
[`chat_codex()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/chat_codex.md)
gives you an ordinary `ellmer` `Chat`: no API key, and no Codex CLI.
That makes it easy to bring language models into your R analysis
workflows.

It uses OpenAI’s documented [“Sign in with
ChatGPT”](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/token-sharing-open-source)
flow for open-source, locally hosted apps, and the public Responses API.
`ellmercodex` is an independent integration and is not affiliated with
or endorsed by OpenAI.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("ellmercodex")
```

Or the development version from GitHub with
[`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

``` r

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("simxnherrera/ellmercodex")
```

If you are upgrading from 0.1.x, sign in again with
[`codex_login()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_login.md):
the authentication flow changed and earlier credentials are not kept.

## Usage

Sign in once; the credential is saved and refreshed for you:

``` r

library(ellmercodex)

codex_login()
```

Then create a chat and talk to it:

``` r

chat <- chat_codex(model = "gpt-6-luna", effort = "low")
chat$chat("Hello from R")
#> Hello! What are you working on in R?
```

Because
[`chat_codex()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/chat_codex.md)
returns an `ellmer` `Chat`, everything you know from `ellmer` applies:
streaming, async, images and PDFs, tool calling, and structured data.
For example, you can classify a speech from a parliamentary debate and
get back an R list instead of prose:

``` r

chat$chat_structured(
  "Classify this excerpt as PREVENTIVE, PUNITIVE, or MIXED drug policy: ...",
  type = ellmer::type_object(
    stance = ellmer::type_enum(c("PREVENTIVE", "PUNITIVE", "MIXED")),
    rationale = ellmer::type_string()
  )
)
```

ChatGPT plan usage is an OpenAI preview: it needs an eligible plan and
workspace, works one conversation at a time, and does not accept
arguments such as `temperature` or `max_tokens`.

## Learn more

- [Get
  started](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/ellmercodex.html):
  sign in, create a chat, and see what works from `ellmer`.
- [Signing in and
  credentials](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/authentication.html):
  how sign-in works, where credentials are stored, and how to sign out.
- [Models and reasoning
  effort](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/models.html):
  list your models, pick one, and set the reasoning effort.
- [Analyzing
  text](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/text-analysis.html):
  structured data and tool calling on a real parliamentary debate.
- [Errors and
  limits](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/articles/errors-and-limits.html):
  what is not supported and how to handle errors.

The [technical
design](https://github.com/simxnherrera/ellmercodex/blob/main/docs/technical-design.md)
and the [`ellmer` compatibility
inventory](https://github.com/simxnherrera/ellmercodex/blob/main/docs/ellmer-chat-interface.md)
document the implementation in depth.

# Package index

## Chat

Create an `ellmer` `Chat` backed by your ChatGPT plan, then use its
usual methods to send messages, stream responses, call tools, and
extract structured data.

- [`chat_codex()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/chat_codex.md)
  : Create a Codex chat backed by ellmer
- [`codex_models()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_models.md)
  : List models available to the authenticated Codex account.

## Authentication

Sign in with ChatGPT in the browser, inspect the stored credential, and
sign out.

- [`codex_login()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_login.md)
  : Sign in with ChatGPT in the browser.
- [`codex_logout()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_logout.md)
  : Sign out and remove ellmercodex's stored credential.
- [`codex_account()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_account.md)
  : Show a redacted Codex authentication summary.

## Diagnostics and errors

- [`codex_available()`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/codex_available.md)
  : Check whether the local ellmercodex integration is available.
- [`ellmercodex-conditions`](https://simxnherrera.github.io/ellmercodex/reference/ellmercodex-conditions.md)
